title: Cohomology of a module sheaf agrees with that of its underlying abelian sheaf
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme with its small Zariski site [def-sc-zariski-site], and let $\mathcal F$ be any sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules. Write $\mathcal F_{\mathrm{ab}}$ for the same sheaf after forgetting the module structure. For every $q\geq0$, the $q$-th right-derived global sections of $\mathcal F$ computed in sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [pqf-def-cohomology] and those of $\mathcal F_{\mathrm{ab}}$ computed in abelian sheaves [def-sc-zariski-cohomology] are canonically isomorphic as abelian groups, naturally in $\mathcal F$.

theorem zariskiModuleAbelianCohomologyNatural (X : Scheme.{u}) (q : ℕ) :
    Nonempty ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace q ⋙
        forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤)))
          AddCommGrpCat.{u}) ≅
      (SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) ⋙
        @CategoryTheory.Sheaf.cohomologyPresheafFunctor.{u, u, u}
          (Opens X.carrier) inferInstance (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier)
          inferInstance
          (@hasExt_of_enoughInjectives _ _ _ inferInstance
            (@IsGrothendieckAbelian.enoughInjectives _ _ _
              (Sheaf.isGrothendieckAbelian_of_essentiallySmall'.{u}
                (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.carrier) AddCommGrpCat.{u}))) q ⋙
        (evaluation (Opens X.carrier)ᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (op ⊤)))
